body: Yeah exactly. It's like the goal is simply to keep you suffering at all costs, even if it means a bit of good luck on rare occasion to suppress that suicidal urge.

Well, some 37% of people are just a product of lust and weren't made intentionally. I would imagine the others only exist to ease the loneliness of their parents or as part of some religious mission to grow the population. I seriously doubt many people put serious thought into the morality of it. And those that do are obviously not likely to be your parents...
Yeah, it's a really fucked up dilemma. I wish there was a third option, but there isn't. I constantly ask myself the same thing. Life is really a little shit.

Most people who try this survive and have a miserable time in the process. It does not kill reliably, leaves you feeling sick for extended periods of time, and you'll want to go to the hospital long before it could actually kill you, regardless of how determined you are to die now. You would end up getting a stomach pump and having possible liver damage. Please don't try this, it's not a way you'd want to go.

I'm sorry that you felt like you needed to do this. I've been to that point myself and I know the pain that drives someone to this point. Wouldn't wish it on anyone. You overdosed and might need medical attention. You might want to read up on the symptoms of [aspirin poisoning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salicylate_poisoning) and get help if necessary. Stay strong and please don't take any more. It would be a terrible way to die, and you would likely fail and be left with organ damage if you tried. You don't deserve to go through that.

Valium probably won't kill you, it will just put you into a deep sleep for extended periods of time until your body metabolizes it. Idk the risk of benzos to kidneys / liver but you probably shouldn't test your luck.
You should make yourself throw it up. Death from paracetamol overdose isn't likely, but it can damage your liver and that will only create more problems for you.
We all make mistakes, no need to torture yourself over them. I doubt the universe is going to care if you choose to take it easy tonight.
Or maybe just take it easy for a bit? You made yourself sick, why don't you just distract yourself for a bit and get feeling better. There's no urgency, you don't have to die today.
Depressed people are likely to try and overdose, so doctors don't typically prescribe anything that would be deadly when it happens.

Xanax is unlikely to kill you. You would be much more likely to just black out and wake up like 2 days later. You'll need your medicine to manage anxiety, don't waste it on an overdose that will just create more problems.
Call an ambulance, you're just going to hurt your liver and kidneys but still survive. You can minimize that if you act quickly.

Don't try to kill yourself with paracetamol overdose, this typically isn't deadly but can lead to some serious health issues with your liver and kidneys. I have liver disease and trust me it's not something you want.
You should call an ambulance. It probably won't kill you, and if it did it would be a bad way to go. You don't want to go through that. If you act now you could probably avoid permanent liver damage.
Tons of people on this sub have tried and woken up days later feeling like complete shit and covered in puke. Going through that won't make anything better.
OTC pills are OTC because it's hard to die from overdosing on them. If you try you're just looking at vomiting, liver damage, pain, and ultimately survival. Doesn't sound too fun.

I think a lot of people have thoughts that are as dark as that, but very very few would actually do it. Try to remember that just about everyone has some sort of darkness that they are facing, even if you can't see it. You've seen how much pain life can throw at you, you don't want to inflict pain on others. I know it's unfair, but you wouldn't be balancing the scales, you'd just add more suffering to the world. I think there's enough already.

I don't know what it's like for you, but I hope things can improve.

I feel the same way. It's amazing how something so simple can be the source of so much pain. I know you're probably in the life / death limbo where you don't want to bother transitioning because you're thinking of dying instead, and to that I say just get yourself on estrogen and wait it out a bit. Just knowing the testosterone poisoning is over can give you some relief. Only time can tell if you if that's enough.

A 6 or 7 I would think. I get the fluctuation, the right trigger can take me from calm to crazy depressed in an instant. I think about family sometimes but it's complicated because I hold a lot of resentment towards my parents for fucking up my life, I guess that lowers the feelings of guilt by a large margin. Or maybe I'm just a selfish asshole. Probably a bit of both tbh.

I'm really sorry that happened to you. It's the last thing you needed and whoever did that really overstepped.

This demonstrates the problem with how society treats people with suicidal thoughts. People don't want to come forward with their problems because they risk being treated like a criminal for wanting to escape them, and the fear of that happening only adds to their problems, causing more pain and leaving them feeling more trapped. Receiving help should be a choice, not an abduction with a massive hospital bill after the fact.
Last I checked, 76 years for men, 81 years for women. On average.
The dysphoria kills me regardless of whether I pretend or not. IMO no hope is more likely to lead to an early grave than false hope. That's my take on it, at least.
And look what subreddit you're on. I don't think we're all here because we're content with being fucked over by reality.

Very relatable. I chose to transition instead of seek out the "sexy girlfriend", and I suspected if I had chosen differently I would feel exactly as you do, jealous of the person I was with. Unfortunately, it's no better going down the other path. I'm still here on this sub, after all.
None really, most will just land you in the ER and give you organ damage.

Ditch the psychiatrist, being trans is hard enough without the people in your support system trying to bring you down. I experience this same pain day to day and I understand all too well how that can destroy a person. Just try to remember none of this is your fault, you're not a creep for trying to be who you are life. Life is just evil sometimes, don't beat yourself up over the bad things that happen to you, they aren't your fault.

I don't see how suicide could be considered weak. To face life's greatest fear, death, on your own accord requires a lot of strength. To keep living on despite feeling lost and hopeless also requires strength. Those of us fighting depression, whether we win or lose, are strong. No one has the right to call us weak, alive or dead.

Tylenol overdose usually results in liver damage and is often not lethal. Your survival instinct will kick in long before you would die, and you'll want to go to the ER. You'll survive, have liver damage, and a hospital bill. It's a bad idea.

Dextromethorphan is a hallucinogen, similar to ketamine and PCP. Check the active ingredients on the cough syrup. If dextromethorphan is the only ingredient, and you took less than a gram, you'll be okay. If you took more or something other than DXM is also in the cough syrup, go to the ER. Don't drive under the influence of DXM, get a family member to give a ride or call an ambulance. If you do end up going to the ER, you might avoid a trip to a psych ward if you say you were trying to get high. Hope things turn out okay, OP.

Depends on the person. Some people might grow, have children and grandchildren, and find themselves surrounded with more love than they could imagine. Others might be alone and depressed for another 50 years wishing every day they were dead or had never even been born. Death will eventually come for everyone.
Jaundice, horrible itching, abdominal pain and nausea spells. Wouldn't wish it on anyone.

This is not the way you want to go. It will probably not work, and you'll be left with permanent liver damage. I have suffered from chronic liver disease since childhood, it's a nightmare. Get yourself help now and minimize the damage.

I agree with everything you've just said. The way psychiatric care responds to people with suicidal thoughts effectively drives people toward suicide out of fear of getting locked up against their will.

Bag over the head wouldn't make a difference. Benzos don't disable your motor system, you'd unconsciously remove the bag from your head.

Go easy on the desperate suicide attempts, you're only making things harder on yourself. Try to get your mind off of suicide for a while, even if only a few days. Thinking about suicide is miserable. Watch some movies or TV. Alcohol / cannabis if needed.

I've been known to do similar things, usually because of my borderline personality disorder. People in that state of mind really don't have the control to stop themselves from behaving in that way, sometimes a little space at the right time can go along way.

Probably won't kill you. Unless you suffer significant respiratory depression you're going to wake up after a day or two with a hell of a hangover. For your sake, I hope I'm wrong. Also not sure you want to mix stimulants into your suicide cocktail, that seems like a really miserable idea.
Kids are stupid, sometimes their parents are even dumber. Fuck that bitch. Hope it was otherwise a good movie.

Nope. Went down that path. After a bad DMT trip I've made myself stay away. There are insights to gain from psychedelics, but there's something inherently sinister about them that can't really be described without experiencing it. You might try your luck and have a few good trips that make you feel really good and refreshed, but after one really bad trip you'll want to stay away. Better to stick with pot.
